after.requirement: If nonzero indentation flags still produce supported indented string output, json_dumps must remain reachable with those flags.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same mask applies to json_dumps on both sides. Callback mode receives unmasked flags but only counts output bytes; whether it provides an equivalent route for this frozen string-output behavior depends on the missing formatting contract.
